highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.147 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and new platform assets.
highlights_body: It introduces SKPathBuilder, color font palettes, CICP color spaces, and sampling-aware surface drawing. This preview also raises WebAssembly native assets to .NET 8 and removes 32-bit Tizen assets.

breaking.title: WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8
breaking.body: Native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are no longer shipped. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno Platform WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later.

breaking.title: Tizen native assets are now 64-bit only
breaking.body: The Skia m147 update removes the EOL 32-bit Tizen arm and x86 assets. Target tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 when upgrading.

breaking.title: HarfBuzz palette colors use HBColor
breaking.body: Face.GetPaletteColors now returns HBColor values instead of raw uint values so HarfBuzz BGRA channels are represented correctly. Update preview code to use HBColor and the ColorExtensions conversions.

breaking.title: Preview API names align with .NET conventions
breaking.body: SKDocumentXpsOptions.DPI is now Dpi, and GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo replaces the differently-cased GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo in GRVkImageInfo. Update source references to the new names.

breaking.title: Large SKStream.Move offsets no longer truncate
breaking.body: SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and now throws OverflowException when the offset does not fit in 32 bits. Use the int overload and validate larger offsets before calling it.

bullets.lead: Bundled engine advances to Skia m147
bullets.detail: The engine update brings SKPathBuilder, additional HDR color types, codec and filter improvements, and CICP color-space support.

bullets.lead: Image and font dependencies are refreshed
bullets.detail: The bundled engine updates libjpeg-turbo, FreeType, zlib, libpng, and libexpat.

bullets.lead: Variable and color fonts gain first-class APIs
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp can query variation axes and palettes, clone typefaces with coordinates or palette overrides, and convert correctly represented HBColor values.
SKWebpEncoder encodes single images or timed frame sequences through stream and span-friendly overloads.
SKStream.GetData returns ref-counted SKData when the stream can provide its contents cheaply.
New APIs add sampling-aware surface drawing, XPS document creation, per-resource GPU flushing, and shader-backed mask filters.

bullets.lead: Font and glyph handling is more robust
bullets.detail: Default typeface resolution no longer crashes during Android or NanoServer initialization, and byte-span glyph checks no longer recurse until a stack overflow.

bullets.lead: Android GL views resume after navigation
bullets.detail: SKGLView retains the correct dimensions when a MAUI tab or page is reattached, avoiding a blank surface.

bullets.lead: Apple library targets regain workload compatibility
bullets.detail: Apple .NET 10 library TFMs use the base 26.0 platform version instead of requiring Xcode 26.2.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalization no longer races its builder
bullets.detail: Pending path mutations are not flushed after disposal starts, preventing a finalizer-thread crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic native assets are available
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now ship linux-bionic packages for x64 and arm64 environments.
New tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 assets replace the retired 32-bit Tizen targets.
Native assets remain available for .NET 8 and later Emscripten toolchains, with a clear build error on unsupported .NET 6 and .NET 7 projects.

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Updates the bundled engine to Skia m147 and adds SKPathBuilder, variable and color-font APIs, CICP color spaces, sampling-aware drawing, Linux Bionic, and 64-bit Tizen assets. It fixes Android typeface initialization, SKGLView reattachment, glyph-span recursion, and negative stream offsets while dropping 32-bit Tizen assets.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData, fixes SKPath finalizer crashes, and restores broad Apple .NET 10 workload compatibility.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Requires .NET 8 or later for WebAssembly native assets and replaces preview palette uint values with HBColor. It adds XPS, per-resource GPU flush, and shader mask-filter APIs, refreshes native dependencies, and prevents NanoServer font initialization crashes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font and color-palette APIs with correctly represented HBColor values, plus Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets.
